title: NL Quadruped Navigation Command Schema v2
description: Continuous 2D world (meters). x=east(right), y=north(up), origin [0,0] at bottom-left.

start.description: Start position [x, y] in meters. Defaults to [0.5, 0.5].

goal.description: Goal position [x, y] in meters, or null when no goal can be inferred.

goal_yaw.description: Optional desired heading at goal in radians, or null.

forbidden_regions.description: Hard obstacles the robot must not enter (collision-level).

soft_avoid_regions.description: Soft regions: passable but penalized when preference=safe.

clearance.description: Extra safety margin (m) to keep from forbidden regions. Default 0.

speed.description: Maps to forward velocity command magnitude. Default normal.

preference.description: shortest: minimize path length; safe: also avoid soft regions; default: no extra shaping.

interpretation_notes.description: Short report of how ambiguous language was interpreted.
